groups.reason: The six boundary summaries aggregate detailed positions; they are not six additional scalar defects. Their current position totals and reasons are assessed through the complete individual record inventory, with no aggregate converted to PASS.

DescriptorParser.parse accepts ConnectionProfileLoader, whose source alias is Callable[[Path, str], dict[str, str]]. The callable alias route is not statically closed; the profile dictionary remains arbitrary-key boundary debt. No changed source substitutes or narrows this contract.

The seven DSL constant routes remain explicit reexports of existing vocabulary constants. The scanner cannot model these as supported callable signatures; this does not establish a missing import, nor justify deleting published vocabulary.

Doctor, Patient and CreditCard remain decorated/property-bearing classes. AST inspection finds no direct class-body if/for/try/while in their definitions; the class_body_control_flow label is a conservative binding limitation. Their full property surface remains unproved, including in the identifier-documentation change.

The two XML parser results are qualified lxml etree._Element types. Their library identity exists in source; unsupported dotted-type resolution does not prove a missing annotation or closed model fields. The source route remains unchanged.

These seven positions retain external Faker/Pydantic/validated aliases and nested authoring sample, XML and allowed-value shapes. Library identity and runtime validation do not establish the complete checker algebra; their UNKNOWN status remains appropriate without replacing them by object or a fabricated DTO.

Statement parent/self references and SourceDistribution.coerce retain legitimate quoted Python types. They remain unresolved through the facade; editing quotation syntax would not establish the semantic closure of those references.

The eleven positions use class objects, Callable factories, TypeGuard or constraint unions containing callable/generic members. Their existing factories and correlations remain meaningful. Unsupported generic expansion remains uncertainty, not approval of every constituent field.

Global context dataflow and dynamic-call coverage remain bounded by the scanner. Direct annotations and selected self-field/constructor bindings do not prove arbitrary runtime values or every callable target; the current unresolved-call count is retained as measured uncertainty separately from scalar boundary positions. Current unresolved calls: 1247 (base 1246). The GeneratorStatement inherited-surface record changes only its evidence reference. Its explicit Statement base is unchanged and the added super().__init__ supplies that existing base initialization. The one added unresolved call is exactly this super().__init__ expression, which the scanner labels dynamic; current total1247. All boundary annotations/reasons and other UNKNOWN records remain unchanged.

All 66 records concern incomplete inherited-method inventories across the listed DSL, Domain, IO and Runtime classes. Current defining bases are retained; MongoDBConnectionValues specifically remains a five-key TypedDict. Inheritance/property/decorator resolution remains unproved even when directly declared fields are typed. This assessment does not certify broad-map or unannotated methods hidden by inherited surfaces.

SetupContext.generators setter still has an unannotated value argument. Its property binding is unresolved, but that does not turn the missing annotation into a pure analyzer limitation. This exact record remains explicit source-contract debt.

The export_session getter/setter annotations remain ExportSession | None. Inherited property binding is unresolved; the optional nominal type is useful but does not prove ExportSession internals or its prepared-row aliases.

The 23 None annotations are setter returns on the reported DSL/Runtime/Domain properties. Their void-return annotations do not close the setter input or inherited property binding. All detailed IDs remain unresolved; none is used to erase separate input debt.
The two use_mp positions retain bool | None, including its unset state. Their inherited getter/setter binding remains unproved; no normalization of None or source change is warranted by the report.
The two report_logging positions retain bool controls. The scanner does not prove their inherited property bindings; accepting the bounded review does not reclassify those records as PASS.

The four serialized_generators/namespace_functions positions retain bytes | None for serialized state. Binding and payload meaning remain separate: a bytes annotation does not certify the contents or dynamic execution.

SetupContext.generators getter remains a bare dict containing heterogeneous generator/cache objects. The property route is unresolved and the map shape is real residual typing debt; this review does not grant a new opaque-map permission.

The clients property uses dict[str, RegisteredClient]. Registry keys are names, while heterogeneous Client/SqlScriptClient alternatives remain unresolved. The inherited property route is not proof that every client shares one database interface.

The namespace property retains dict[str, object] for native scripting state. Its exact historical permissions remain scoped; inherited binding uncertainty does not authorize arbitrary new opaque control fields.

The properties getter/setter retain string maps or native object-valued maps. This preserves descriptor/runtime property inputs and existing exact permissions, while inherited binding and native value closure remain unproved.
BankAccount.balance getter/setter retain float values. Their inherited/decorated property binding is unresolved; no changed head alters this value contract.
The eight num_process/process_id positions retain int | None. Optional execution controls are unchanged and their inherited bindings remain unproved; the policy fixes do not erase this uncertainty.

CompositeStatement.sub_statements retains list[Statement]. The ordered DSL child relationship remains explicit; unresolved property binding does not warrant replacing the statement model or duplicating accessors.

BaseLiteralGenerator.rng retains random.Random at its getter/setter. The qualified stdlib identity and inherited property route remain separate limitations; these records do not certify arbitrary generator behavior.

GenerateStatement.targets retains set[str]. The strings are declared target expressions, not a newly invented fixed-record shape. Inherited getter/setter binding remains unproved, including where target sets are copied into export metadata.

GenerateStatement.count retains str | None because count may be an expression or absent. The source contract and inherited property uncertainty remain unchanged; narrowing to int would change DSL behavior.
The ten default dataset/locale/separator/prefix/suffix property positions retain str annotations. Current bindings remain statically unproved; no changed source introduces a different field meaning.

RdbmsConnectionConfig.get_connection_config still returns BaseModel.model_dump from extra=allow configuration. Arbitrary engine kwargs and nested values preclude a scalar-only map claim; the missing return annotation remains an explicit source obligation, unchanged in all reviewed heads.

Memstore.removeNotExistingIds still invokes the injected client get_random_rows_by_columns, consumes row[0], stringifies IDs and retains surviving row objects. The client parameter remains unannotated; concrete DatabaseClient does not supply this full structural contract. This is retained source debt, not a fabricated protocol acceptance.

Memstore.get_data_by_type still returns its live stored value and preserves the logged, chained missing-key KeyError. Its unannotated return and open row shape remain source debt; a read protocol does not validate all stored payloads or their mutation identity.

Memstore.get_all_data_by_type still returns the original stored rows or a new empty list, without validating row shape. The missing return annotation remains source debt; no closed row model or copy semantics are inferred.

Statement.get_parent_full_name still calls split on full_name, which may be None, and joins all but the final component. The successful result is a string, but the missing annotation remains source debt and the existing AttributeError path is not silently repaired by this architecture review.

These six qualified random.Random positions retain real stdlib RNG identity and optional RNG inputs. Dotted-type support is incomplete in the analyzer; changing imports merely to change verdicts would not improve their semantic contracts.

The 39 positions retain Path, Random, timedelta and Traversable library types at exact direct/nested positions. These identities represent real filesystem/RNG/time/resource interfaces; full external surfaces remain unproved, separately from any scalar budget that excludes external_type.

BaseDomainService preserves generated-model TypeVar identity, and IO selectors preserve input element T through lists/iterators. Their generic boundary algebra remains unproved. Neither object substitution nor concrete narrowing is authorized; current selector body changes preserve the same element correlation.

AuthoringReferenceQuery remains an Annotated discriminated union with Pydantic category metadata. Runtime validation and category/kind correlation are intentional; escaped alias binding and complete union expansion remain unproved at request/return.query.

RegisteredClient remains Client | SqlScriptClient across all 21 reported IO/Runtime positions. The heterogeneous registry deliberately supports distinct client capabilities; binding uncertainty does not justify narrowing every operation to one database implementation.

GroupMask retains distinct dictionaries with string, age-interval tuple or SexKey keys and float weights. The source normalizers preserve key correlations; alias binding remains unproved and there is no blanket mapping grant.

PreparedPage retains the native prepared tuple, metadata and mutable XML row dictionaries. IO still owns conversion/dispatch, while Runtime determines ordering. Broad payloads remain visible but escaped alias binding is unproved; this grants no new field-level opacity permission.

ClientConfig remains the RDBMS/MongoDB configuration union. Both nominal alternatives and their nested/native configuration surfaces must be resolved before closure; existing arbitrary engine configuration remains unproved.

The nested-source return retains recursive JSON scalar/list/object alternatives alongside CSV and native memstore rows. Recursive JsonValue is not a proven closed checker algebra; the existing exact native-arm permissions do not become a blanket JSON grant.

Rule remains the StateTransitionRule alias and transitions retain str | Iterable[Rule]. Transition ordering, conditions and model identity remain intact; the factory reuse fix does not prove escaped alias binding or complete model fields.
JsonObject remains dict[str, pydantic.JsonValue]. The recursive external value algebra and arbitrary object keys remain unproved; no scalar-only JSON restriction is inferred.

SexKey remains str | None across all six demographic positions, including age-band maps and weight keys. None is a meaningful unspecified category with fallback behavior; alias uncertainty does not authorize erasing it.

PyType remains type | tuple[type, ...] in all seven FieldSpec routes. The catalogue records Python type alternatives, not ordinary payload instances. Alias binding and type-object algebra remain unproved; replacing them with object would lose meaning.
